acceptance: Each file's current rule outcome is recorded
The outcome decision is recorded with the evidence, and any change shows in the snapshot diff
description:
## Problem
Two stored TPC-DS SF 1 results from 2026-08-26 returned wrong row counts: ClickHouse local (c250741b) q31 one row short on three streams; DataFusion 53 SQL (5207d224) q34 and q73 short on most streams. DuckDB on data from the same generator returns the reference counts, and the statement text is identical to today's. The new integrity checks apply only to new runs, so the rule does not see these errors.

## Change
Record each file's current rule outcome. If either is ranked, decide (owner) between a manifest known-defect entry through the existing corpus admission policy and leaving it, without editing stored files.

## Guardrails
Never edit stored result files; any outcome change shows in the compliance snapshot diff.
